title.zh: 持有期限与被年收益掩盖的损失

scope.en: Recomputed from 2,838 frozen NAV observations, 2015–2026. Overlapping windows are dependent; these are descriptive historical paths, not executable returns or independent trials.
scope.zh: 我们重算了2015至2026年的2838个冻结净值观测，用于描述历史路径。滚动窗口彼此重叠，观测相互依赖，收益能否实际实现仍待验证。

negativeFraction.en: Fraction of windows with a loss
